children: ICICI Securities research report on Brigade Enterprises

Brigade Enterprises (BRGD) had a muted Q1FY27 with no major launches, resulting in sales bookings of INR 11bn (down 5% YoY). However, with the Sep’26 launch of Brigade Barcelona in Hyderabad (GDV of INR 27bn), launches are finally picking up pace. Management remains confident of achieving INR 90bn of FY27 sales bookings (20% YoY growth), driven by launches with GDV of ~INR 100bn in FY27. We currently model forFY27E/FY28E sales bookings of INR 92/INR 113bn, factoring in BRGD’s strong launch pipeline.

Further, BRGD plans to double its hotel and annuity asset portfolio over FY26–31, with 1,700 incremental hotel keys and ~10msf of annuity assets. Retain BUY with an unchanged SoTP-based TP of INR 885.
